scope: independent read-only qualification wrapper and workflow review; no command/test execution

findings.finding: Workflow CARGO_TARGET_DIR points to runner temporary owner-local-target, but wrapper deletes and reads hardcoded workspace target/nextest/local/junit.xml. Profile is local; junit.path is relative junit.xml. Use actual successful cargo metadata target_directory so fresh JUnit is resolved in the active target tree.
findings.correction: Nextest store.dir defaults to target/nextest within the workspace root and JUnit path is relative to store.dir/profile. This store is independent from Cargo compilation target_directory. No store override is present. The owner observed actual nextest 0.9.151 output at WORKSPACE/target/nextest/local/junit.xml with external CARGO_TARGET_DIR and no external target/nextest/local. The original wrapper path is correct; the suggested metadata.target_directory change must not be made.

findings.finding: Both jobs only accept github.head_ref matching the PR branch. workflow_dispatch has no head_ref and skips both jobs. If manual dispatch is intended, include event/ref condition explicitly.
